summary: options.display_progress is stored as string 'true' not boolean, allowing a third value 'auto'
emit_event sends script-messages with 'webm-' prefix to allow external event listeners
mpopts.read_options(options) is called immediately after the options table definition, allowing script-opts overrides
run_subprocess_popen uses io.popen on a shell-escaped string; additional_flags tokenized by whitespace before escaping, so spaces in flag values split across arguments
Two subprocess execution paths: run_subprocess (argv array via utils.subprocess, safe) and run_subprocess_popen (shell string via io.popen, used for progress display)
seconds_to_time_string returns 'unknown' for negative seconds; full=true forces hours component
shell_escape quotes individual argv tokens using single-quotes (POSIX) or double-quotes (Windows); on Windows wraps entire concatenated string in an extra pair of double-quotes
expand_properties supports conditional templates: ${?prop:val}, ${!prop:val}, ${?prop==compare:val}, ${=prop} for raw value
run_subprocess_popen appends '2>&1' to the shell command string, redirecting stderr to stdout for progress parsing
get_video_dimensions caches the OSD-to-video coordinate mapping in _video_dimensions; cache is invalidated by any of 11 observed mpv properties
get_video_dimensions returns nil if video-out-params is nil (no video loaded); callers must handle nil
90-degree video rotation is handled by swapping w/h and dw/dh before computing display dimensions
monitor_dimensions registers 11 mp.observe_property calls; these observers persist for the script lifetime
split_scaling computes pixel start/end for a scaled/panned/zoomed source, clamping degenerate zero-size case to [0,1]
VideoPoint uses (-1,-1) as uninitialized sentinel; set_from_screen clamps to video bounds before converting
Region.is_valid returns true iff all four fields (x,y,w,h) are > -1; a zero-dimension region is considered valid
quote: return self.x > -1 and self.y > -1 and self.w > -1 and self.h > -1

summary: VideoPoint.set_from_screen will error if get_video_dimensions() returns nil (no video loaded)
make_fullscreen_region creates a Region with x=0,y=0,w=video_w,h=video_h; returns nil if no video-out-params
get_duration references undefined local 'reversed_binary_duration' instead of 'big_endian_binary_duration'; would cause runtime error if called
VP8 first-pass logfile has 144-byte records; duration field is a little-endian IEEE-754 double scaled by 1e7 (10ns units)
vp8_patch_logfile sets all frame durations to average duration and sets last frame to total encode duration
read_double returns 0 for both true zero and denormal numbers (exponent == 0 check)
If VP8 logfile size is not a multiple of 144 bytes (corrupt), remaining bytes are silently discarded
Format base class defines the interface: getPreFilters, getPostFilters, getFlags, getCodecFlags, postCommandModifier
WebmVP8 is the only format with supportsTwopass=true; its postCommandModifier patches the VP8 first-pass logfile
Format instances are registered in the global formats table keyed by string ID (e.g. 'webm-vp8')
5 format classes registered: webm-vp9, mp4, mp4-nvenc, mp3, plus webm-vp8 from SEG-05
options.output_format default 'mp4 (h264/AAC)' does not match any formats table key; would cause formats[options.output_format] to return nil unless EncodeOptionsPage initializes it correctly
MP3 format has empty videoCodec, making it audio-only; getCodecFlags omits --ovc flag
WebmVP9 overrides getFlags to add libvpx_threads option; supportsTwopass=false
GIF postCommandModifier builds a two-step lavfi filtergraph: palettegen followed by paletteuse for palette-optimized GIF
GIF uses raw seconds (not HH:MM:SS) for trim=start:end to avoid colon syntax issues in filter graph
Unknown --vf-add=lavfi- prefixed filters not in the handled list are silently dropped from the GIF filter chain
GIF format has acceptsBitrate=false; bitrate calculation in encode() is skipped
startEncode appends an empty table to copy_command_line (append(copy_command_line, {})) - vestigial no-op artifact
Page.add_keybinds uses mp.add_forced_key_binding with repeatable=true for all keys
EncodeWithProgress.startEncode returns true only when finishedReason == 'End of file'; any abnormal exit returns false
EncodeWithProgress parses stderr for 'Encode time-pos: X' and 'Exiting... (reason)' patterns; all other stderr lines silently ignored
Page uses mp.add_forced_key_binding (not mp.add_key_binding) - forced bindings override all other key handlers
calculate_bitrate: total_kilobits = target_filesize * 8; strict constraint reserves strict_audio_bitrate*length for audio; video gets remainder
append_audio_tracks builds amix lavfi-complex filter for multiple internal audio tracks

get_metadata_flags uses length-prefix format (%N%value) to safely embed filenames in command line without injection risk
get_contrast_brightness_and_saturation_filters compares string property values to 0 numerically via Lua coercion; may fail for non-numeric values

When run_detached=true, temp cache_dump.ts and pass1 logfile are never cleaned up (early return before cleanup code)
encode() supports three execution modes: detached subprocess, blocking argv subprocess, blocking popen with progress overlay
additional_flags and non_strict_additional_flags are tokenized by whitespace and appended directly to command; could override --o= output path
HLS stream: cache dumped to ~/cache_dump.ts; startTime reset to 0, endTime adjusted to relative duration
encode() emits 'encode-started' before encoding and 'encode-finished' with 'success' or 'fail' result
CropPage draws crop overlay as four dark rectangles (letterbox) around the selected region using ASS draw commands
CropPage keybinds: '1'=setPointA, '2'=setPointB, 'r'=reset, 'ESC'=cancel, 'ENTER'=finish
cancel calls callback(nil); finish creates Region from pointA/B and calls callback(region)
Zero-dimension crop (pointA == pointB) passes is_valid() check but would produce invalid crop filter params
Option widget supports three types: bool (toggle), int (bounded/unbounded numeric), list (enumeration with display names)
List type getValue returns possibleValues[i][1] (the key); getDisplayValue returns possibleValues[i][2] (display name) or key if no display name
optVisible uses visibleCheckFn callback to conditionally hide options; enables format-conditional visibility
Bool leftKey and rightKey both toggle value identically; no directional behavior for booleans

EncodeOptionsPage builds 11 Option widgets; confirmOpts applies all values to global options table
gif_dither option uses visibleCheckFn to show only when output_format=='gif'
EncodeOptionsPage keybinds: UP/DOWN navigate options, LEFT/RIGHT change values, ENTER=confirm, ESC=cancel
PreviewPage saves vf/time-pos/pause at construction, adds crop+sub filters in prepare(), and restores all in dispose()

Bootstrap binds 'W' key (options.keybind) via mp.add_key_binding and registers 'file-loaded' event to auto-set times
MainPage is the UI state machine root; c/1/2/o/p/e/ESC navigate to crop/settime/options/preview/encode/idle states
